chunks: Hisham ibn Salim narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
"There is no harm in delaying the visitation of the House until the days of Tashriq have passed, except that you must not approach women or use perfume."

key_terms.أَيَّامُ التَّشْرِيقِ: the days of Tashriq following Eid al-Adha during hajj
key_terms.زِيَارَةَ: the visitation, referring here to the ritual visit to the Sacred House

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to delay the ziyarat of the Ka'bah until after the days of Tashriq?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning delaying the ziyarat al-bayt during hajj rites. It permits the delay until after the days of Tashriq, while maintaining the restriction against intimacy with women and the use of perfume until the rite is completed.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2785 - Hisham ibn Salim narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said: "
There is no harm in delaying the visitation of the Kaaba (Tawaf al-Ziyara) until the days of Tashreeq have passed, except that you must not approach women or use perfume."
